description: Overlay window: needs only core:event:allow-listen for its 5 streaming-caption listen() calls (show-overlay, stream-text, phase, mic-level, hide-overlay). Hotkey registration is Rust-side (GlobalShortcutExt, not JS IPC) so no global-shortcut capability is needed. Custom #[tauri::command]s (cancel_operation) are allowed from all windows by default.
